claims.statement: According to Yokai.com, sazae oni are powerful shape-changers, often taking the form of beautiful women to lure seamen into trouble; at sea they pose as drowning victims and, once brought aboard, turn on their rescuers.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Yokai.com, sazae oni adalah pengubah wujud yang kuat, sering menjelma perempuan cantik untuk menjerumuskan pelaut; di laut mereka berpura-pura menjadi korban tenggelam dan, setelah dibawa naik kapal, menyerang para penolongnya.
claims.quote: They are powerful shape-changers, often taking the form of beautiful women in order to lure seamen into trouble. At sea, they pretend to be drowning victims and cry out to be rescued, only to turn on their would-be saviors once brought aboard.

claims.statement: According to Yokai.com, on land sazae oni often travel disguised as lone wandering women who stop at inns and eat the innkeepers during the night.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Yokai.com, di darat sazae oni sering mengembara menyamar sebagai perempuan sendirian yang singgah di penginapan lalu memakan pemilik penginapan pada malam hari.
claims.quote: When encountered on land, sazae oni often travel disguised as lone, wandering women who stop at inns and eat the innkeepers during the night.

claims.statement: According to Yokai.com, a turban snail that reaches 30 years old was thought to turn into a yokai with all kinds of magical powers; another way is when a lustful young woman is thrown into the sea.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Yokai.com, siput turbo yang mencapai usia 30 tahun dipercaya menjadi yōkai dengan segala macam kekuatan sihir; cara lain, perempuan muda yang bernafsu dilemparkan ke laut.
claims.quote: It was thought that when a turban snail reaches 30 years old, it would turn into a yokai with all kinds of magical powers. Another way that sazae oni come to be is when a lustful young woman is thrown into the sea.

claims.statement: According to Yokai.com, on the Kii peninsula a legend tells of a band of pirates who spotted a drowning woman one night and rescued her; the woman was actually a shape-changed sazae oni.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Yokai.com, di Semenanjung Kii ada legenda tentang sekelompok bajak laut yang melihat seorang perempuan tenggelam pada suatu malam dan menyelamatkannya; perempuan itu ternyata sazae oni yang berubah wujud.
claims.quote: On the Kii penninsula, legend tells of a band of pirates who spotted a woman drowning in the water one night. They rescued her ... the woman was actually a shape-changed sazae oni

claims.statement: In that legend, according to Yokai.com, the sazae oni demanded treasure as ransom and the desperate pirates handed over all their ill-gotten gold to it.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda itu, menurut Yokai.com, sazae oni menuntut harta sebagai tebusan dan para bajak laut menyerahkan seluruh emas hasil jarahan mereka kepadanya.
claims.quote: At the end of the night she had all of their testicles, and demanded treasure for their return. The desperate pirates traded away all of their ill-gotten gold to the sazae oni

claims.statement: Yokai.com gives 栄螺鬼 (さざえおに) with the translation "turban snail demon" and oceans, seas and coastal areas as habitat.
claims.statement_id: Yokai.com menulis 栄螺鬼 (さざえおに) dengan terjemahan "iblis siput turbo" dan habitat samudra, laut, dan wilayah pesisir.
claims.quote: Sazae oni 栄螺鬼 さざえおに Translation: turban snail demon Habitat: oceans, seas, and coastal areas

claims.statement: The Goetia ranks Seere as its seventieth spirit.
claims.statement_id: Goetia menempatkan Seere sebagai roh ke-70.
claims.quote: 17世紀のグリモワール『ゴエティア』によると、26の軍団を支配する序列70番の地獄の強大な君主である。

claims.statement: One account places him under the eastern king Amaymon.
claims.statement_id: Satu kisah menempatkannya di bawah Amaymon, raja dari timur.
claims.quote: 東の王であるアマイモンの配下にあるという。 ... 一方、ヨーハン・ヴァイヤーが1577年に発表した『悪魔の偽王国』には『ゴエティア』と共通する悪魔が数多く登場するが、何故かセーレは登場していない。

claims.statement: He appears as a handsome man riding a winged horse.
claims.statement_id: Ia tampak sebagai pria rupawan yang menunggangi kuda bersayap.
claims.quote: He is depicted as a man riding a winged horse, and he is said to be beautiful.

claims.statement: The text credits him with rapid travel around the world.
claims.statement_id: Teks itu menyebut ia dapat bergerak sangat cepat ke seluruh dunia.
claims.quote: 移動したり、ものを運んだりする能力を持っており、瞬きする間に世界中のどこにでも運べるという。

claims.statement: In the Goetia text the seventieth spirit is Seere (also Sear or Seir), a mighty prince under Amaymon, King of the East, who appears as a beautiful man riding a winged horse.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks Goetia, roh ke-70 adalah Seere (juga Sear atau Seir), pangeran perkasa di bawah Amaymon, Raja Timur, yang tampil sebagai pria rupawan menunggang kuda bersayap.
claims.quote: The Seventieth Spirit is Seere, Sear, or Seir. He is a Mighty Prince, and Powerful, under AMAYMON, King of the East. He appeareth in the Form of a Beautiful Man, riding upon a Winged Horse.

claims.statement: According to the Goetia text his office is to go and come, bring many things to pass suddenly, and carry or recarry anything; he can cross the entire Earth in the blink of an eye.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks Goetia, tugasnya pergi dan datang, mewujudkan banyak hal dengan tiba-tiba, serta membawa atau membawa kembali apa pun; ia dapat melintasi seluruh bumi dalam sekejap mata.
claims.quote: His Office is to go and come; and to bring abundance of things to pass on a sudden, and to carry or recarry anything whither thou wouldest have it to go, or whence thou wouldest have it from. He can pass over the whole Earth in the twinkling of an Eye.

claims.statement: According to the Goetia text he gives a true account of all sorts of theft and hidden treasure, is of an indifferent good nature, is willing to do anything the Exorcist desires, and governs 26 legions of spirits.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks Goetia, ia memberi laporan benar tentang segala pencurian dan harta tersembunyi, berwatak cenderung baik, bersedia melakukan apa pun yang diinginkan sang pemanggil (exorcist), dan memimpin 26 legiun roh.
claims.quote: He giveth a True relation of all sorts of Theft, and of Treasure hid, and of many other things. He is of an indifferent Good Nature, and is willing to do anything which the Exorcist desireth. He governeth 26 Legions of Spirits.

claims.statement: Wikipedia says he can go to any place on earth in a matter of seconds to accomplish the will of the conjurer, bring abundance, help find hidden treasures or in robbery, and is not a demon of evil but of good nature, mostly indifferent to evilness.
claims.statement_id: Wikipedia menyebut ia dapat pergi ke tempat mana pun di bumi dalam hitungan detik demi kehendak sang pemanggil, membawa kelimpahan, membantu menemukan harta tersembunyi atau dalam pencurian, dan bukan iblis jahat melainkan berwatak baik serta acuh pada kejahatan.
claims.quote: He can go to any place on earth in a matter of seconds to accomplish the will of the conjurer, bring abundance, help in finding hidden treasures or in robbery, and is not a demon of evil but good nature, being mostly indifferent to evilness.

claims.statement: Wikipedia records the spelling Seir (also Seire, Seere, Sear) and calls him a Prince of Hell with 26 legions of demons under his command.
claims.statement_id: Wikipedia mencatat ejaan Seir (juga Seire, Seere, Sear) dan menyebutnya Pangeran Neraka yang memimpin 26 legiun iblis.
claims.quote: Seir (also Seire, Seere, Sear) is a Prince of Hell, having 26 legions of demons under his command.
